title: A Royal Montana Christmas
overview: A princess looking to decompress before the holidays heads to a Montana ranch and meets a charming guide.

title: 'Tis the Season to Be Irish
overview: A house flipper heads to Ireland to renovate and sell a cottage, but her plans change when she meets a local realtor determined to preserve his town’s heritage.

title: Sugarplummed
overview: Emily's wish for a picture-perfect Christmas comes true when a magical, optimistic movie character steps off the screen to help, but as things spiral out of control, she learns that true holiday perfection might look very different from what she imagined.

title: Christmas Next Door
overview: Eric Randall, an author of bachelor lifestyle books, is left in charge of his young niece and nephew for the holidays. Eric turns to his neighbor April, a lover of all things Christmas, for help.
